content.subject: Re: Halverson-Reedy matter — checking in (again)
content.body:
Good morning,

I hope this finds everyone well. I'm sure you're all very busy over there, which is probably why my last two messages have gone unanswered. I completely understand — I'm certain my little fender-bender file isn't anywhere near the top of the pile.

I did want to gently follow up, though, since it has now been about six weeks since we spoke about the medical records request and the demand letter timeline. At the time, I believe someone mentioned a two-week window. Perhaps your team forgot, or perhaps that estimate was more aspirational than anything else. Either way, I thought I'd check in, just in case my file has slipped behind a stack of paperwork somewhere.

I'd also love an update on the conversation with Pinnacle Mutual's adjuster. I assume something has happened on that front, though of course I have no way of knowing, because no one has shared anything with me. I'm sure there are very good reasons for that, and I'm trying not to be one of those clients who pesters her attorney's office, but at some point silence does start to feel like an answer all its own.

If I don't hear back by the end of the week, I'll just assume you've moved on to more interesting work and start looking around for someone who has the bandwidth to actually return calls. No hard feelings — I know how it goes.

Thanks so much for your time, as always. I really do appreciate everything the team has done. Truly.

Warmly,
Marguerite Halverson-Reedy
